title: Amneal Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: – Q2 2026 Net Revenue of $796 million ; GAAP Net Income of $58 million ; Diluted Income per Share of $0.18 – – Adjusted EBITDA of $206 million ; Adjusted Diluted EPS of $0.30 – – Raising 2026 Full Year Guidance – – Successful Debt Repricing in July Reduces Interest Cost – BRIDGEWATER, N.J., July 30, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Amneal Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (Nasdaq: AMRX) (“Amneal” or the “Company”) today announced its results for the second quarter ended June 30, 2026. “Amneal delivered strong, broad-based performance in the second quarter and first half of 2026, reflecting the strength of our diversified portfolio and the contributions from multiple growth drivers. This robust first-half performance gives us confidence to raise our full-year 2026 guidance for the second time this year.
